historical_commentary.text: DataAnalyzer documents the internal binary layout of the classic DB4D data engine (128-byte blocks, address-table trees, block headers) used by both 4D and the now-defunct Wakanda product; this deep byte-level knowledge is now a niche/legacy diagnostic skill since Wakanda was discontinued and 4D's storage internals have continued to evolve, though the general debugging philosophy (inspecting raw data files when corruption is suspected) remains valid.
related_updates: 4D's built-in Verify/Repair and newer data-file diagnostic tooling in later 4D versions
Wakanda product discontinued, removing half of this note's stated audience
4D Server administration tools now expose higher-level integrity/health reporting than manual hex inspection
